prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1330; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's okay. I can answer your questions.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot near a shopping center in Pasadena, Texas. I was pulling into an open space near the store entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was moving slowly, maybe five miles an hour, looking for a spot. Then the other car backed out of a space and hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?

A: No. I didn't see it until it was already moving toward me. I'm not sure the driver saw me either.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes, my neck. It snapped forward and then back. I've had a stiff neck and some soreness in my shoulders since then.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. They said it was a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do some stretching.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, some. It's better than it was, but I still get stiffness when I turn my head quickly, and I've had trouble sleeping on my left side.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: No. I didn't hit anything, and I didn't black out. I was just shaken up.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been keeping my receipts for the medical visits and prescriptions, and I can send those to you.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
